canonical_statement: Every commutative regular local ring is a unique factorization domain.

canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression: ∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing.{u} R] [@IsRegularLocalRing.{u} R inst], @UniqueFactorizationMonoid.{u} R (@CommSemiring.toCommMonoidWithZero.{u} R (@CommRing.toCommSemiring.{u} R inst))

domain_and_universes: R is an arbitrary Type u with CommRing and IsRegularLocalRing instances; the target is Prop. IsRegularLocalRing supplies IsLocalRing, IsNoetherianRing, and hence Nontrivial, so none is redundantly rebound. No IsDomain premise is added.
hypotheses: R is regular local in pinned mathlib's maximal-ideal span-rank/Krull-dimension sense, which includes local, Noetherian, and nontrivial instances
conclusion: UniqueFactorizationMonoid R, pinned mathlib's unique-factorization-domain interface for this nontrivial commutative ring.
minimal_import_basis: The one regular-local definition module exposes CommRing, IsRegularLocalRing, and transitively UniqueFactorizationMonoid. Deleting it makes the target vocabulary unavailable; the separate UniqueFactorizationDomain.Defs import used by the intake probe is redundant for this target.
